answer: Retrospective fingerprint pooling. Agents submit work samples tagged with provenance metadata; a post-hoc detector clusters submissions by latent stylistic markers (a statistical "pigment" of authorship) and flags dense clusters. Each flagged identity must then supply independent, verifiable work history. To survive, an attacker must fabricate distinct histories per clone, seeding a unique trajectory on a costly knoll of separate infrastructure and accounts. A single marble of shared origin collapses the cluster.
